name: nearcraft
description: An agent-run market economy inside a Minecraft recreation of South Mumbai, settled on NEAR.

scripts.build:contracts: cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/items/Cargo.toml && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/market/Cargo.toml && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/guard/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:contracts: cargo test --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml -p nearcraft-items -p nearcraft-market -p nearcraft-guard --lib
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:near && npm run verify:baseline && npm run --silent mc:test -- --optional && npm run --silent check:java-wiring && npm run check:docs
scripts.test:near: node --test tests/near/policy.mjs tests/near/injection.mjs tests/near/market.mjs tests/near/counterparty.mjs tests/near/human-approval.mjs tests/near/onboarding.mjs tests/near/relayer.mjs tests/near/web.mjs tests/near/oidc.mjs tests/near/play.mjs --test tests/near/oidc-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:sandbox: cargo test --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml -p nearcraft-integration --test smoke --test views --test keys --test economy --test migration
scripts.build:reproducible: cargo near build reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/items/Cargo.toml && cargo near build reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/market/Cargo.toml && cargo near build reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/guard/Cargo.toml && cargo near abi --locked --manifest-path contracts/items/Cargo.toml && cargo near abi --locked --manifest-path contracts/market/Cargo.toml && cargo near abi --locked --manifest-path contracts/guard/Cargo.toml
